acquisition method: MS data were acquired using a data-dependent top 12 method
alkylation reagent: The reduced cysteines were alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide
alkylation concentration: The reduced cysteines were alkylated with 55 mM iodoacetamide
cleavage agent: digestion buffer containing Sequencing grade Trypsin
collision energy: normalized collision energy 25% and isolation width of 3.0 m/z
fractionation method: subjected to SDS-PAGE and Western Blotting
fragmentation method: For HCD spectra resolution was set to 35000
instrument: injected on a quadrupole Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer
labeling: The nLC-MS/MS analysis of gel bands resulted in the identification of seven proteins
reduction reagent: Disulfide bridges were reduced using 10 mM DTT
reduction concentration: Disulfide bridges were reduced using 10 mM DTT
